Independent algebraic reconstruction of the prefix/Abel deficit
correctness.rationale: On the right exterior half-line the maximal profile is a decreasing convex envelope, so its positive increments are nonincreasing and are majorized by the singleton increments \(s_j=1/[(j+1)(j+2)]\). The second-rightmost support point improves the prefix at \(L\) by at least \(1/[(L+1)(2L+1)]\). Abel summation of \(s_j^2-d_j^2\) against prefix defects is nonnegative termwise, and retaining the \(L-1\) term gives exactly the tail loss \(2/[L(L+1)^2(L+2)(2L+1)]\). Inserting this into the published \(2m\)-boundary decomposition and dividing by \(\|\Delta 1_S\|_2^2=2m\) yields the stated deficit. The packaged finite checks agree with these exact identities but are not used as the infinite proof.
residual_risks: The explicit deficit is not asserted optimal and sharpens only one exterior tail.
